originality.rationale: The closest primary paper (Barber–Ruškuc 2026) proves only a Clifford diagonal-subsemigroup injection and χ bound, expressly not an exhaustive classification. Its general congruence-pair background does not imply the new group-fiber labeling of every reflexive compatible relation. The 2025 work gives the finite-group baseline. Published-index and direct-title/alias searches found no result with full coverage; this is evidence of no located coverage, not an absolute novelty proof. The intrinsic general classification and normal-lattice invariance remain distinct, with the historical equivalence risk documented.

value.rationale: The central object is the complete lattice of diagonal subsemigroups of the natural constant-fiber Clifford monoids Y×G. Exhaustive normal-lattice descriptions settle a precise missing case beyond the previously known injective Clifford construction. The normal-subgroup-lattice invariance works for arbitrary finite nonabelian groups and gives exact infinite families of DSC coefficients and an explicit strict quantitative inequality, not merely isolated table entries.
